od_nightshade_chaser.name: OD Nightshade Chaser
notes: No additional OD cost; requires OD Nightshade Pulse. Knockdown/juggle advantage is not grounded hitstun.

od_nightshade_chaser_burst.name: OD Nightshade Chaser Burst
notes: Detonates an unhit projectile; cannot simply add its damage to two already-connected Pulse hits. Variant recorded but not automatically chained.
